observations.annotation_burden: The signed dot plot permits phase comparison using ratios while retaining labels for different resource units; the caption prevents summing percentages or interpreting native probe counts as costs.
observations.reproduction: Square, triangle and cross shapes retain all three roles; direct signs/values and zero line preserve higher versus lower use. Expanded left domain leaves negative labels clear of the metric labels.

initial_reconstruction.claim: Most pooled token/API/native-probe reductions originate in the donor phase. Recipients use fewer total tokens but have slightly more API attempts and native probes, and greater summed session time. Whole session time increases despite a small donor timing reduction.
quantities: Horizontal positions are pooled resource reductions in percent using 100(1 - EAL / ordinary). Rows are four distinct resources: summed session time, native probe call counts, API attempt counts and total tokens. Positive means lower EAL use, negative higher EAL use.

Blue squares, orange triangles and gray crosses match donor, ten recipients and whole (1+10), respectively. All four rows contain those three glyphs. Whole is explicitly a sum of phases rather than a third phase.
initial_reconstruction.evidence_status: Derived descriptive reductions from observed accounting and timing/count instrumentation. No inferential interval. Native probes are counts, not costs.
initial_reconstruction.scope: For each row and each role, the denominator is the ordinary pooled resource total for that role. The same 192 paired trajectories contain 192 donors, 1,920 recipients and 2,112 whole sessions per arm. Timing excludes sequence setup so disjoint donor and recipient time sums add exactly to whole session time. The percentage reductions themselves are not additive.
unintended_inferences: Donor gains dominate whole count reductions, while recipient increases are visible. Metrics cannot be treated as equivalent costs despite sharing a percent axis. Whole percent is a denominator-weighted reduction and not a sum of phase percentages. No temporal causal decomposition is established.
